name: Nanobots2
title: Nanobots: Early Bots 2.0
author: Nexela
description: Early ghost building robots. A special nanobot gun automatically revives blueprint ghosts near you if you have the items in your inventory. Also reprograms personal construction bots to deconstruct items on the ground. A fork of Nanobots, fixed for 2.x. Thank you Nexela for creating this great mod.
